author: deranghg
quote: In my opinion, GTA 6 is a disappointing game because the story is simply not that good and lacks excitement. The missions can get boring, and the characters are not as interesting as expected. On top of that, the game has way too many bugs and glitches, which ruin the overall experience. For a game that took so many years to develop and cost so much money, I expected much more. Overall, GTA 6 just doesn't live up to the hype.
